Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Rider and driver: the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider. No compensation is payable to the driver. The fee stands or falls on the waiting clock, and the clock does not reach the required period.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

Rider advocate8 claim(s), 8 kept

  1. On the driver's own trace, his stationary in-geofence dwell at the pickup pin is 195 seconds.

    Read the whole claim

    The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec as POL-NS-01(c) directs and not the 180-second default. The shortfall is 105 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable on that shortfall alone - whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to any message - so the $4.00 charged must be refunded in full.

    EV-GPS-00203, EV-TRIP-00203, EV-FARE-00203 · POL-NS-06

  2. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and limb (c) is broken.

    Read the whole claim

    Limb (c) demands that the driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force; the measured run is 195 seconds against the 300 seconds carried by trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec for this STANDARD pickup. The rider wins by breaking a single limb, and the break is on the driver's own telemetry, not on any inference.

    EV-GPS-00203, EV-TRIP-00203 · POL-NS-01

  3. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails independently.

    Read the whole claim

    It requires the termination to fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20, the 300-second period would have run out at about 19:46:20; the driver cancelled at 19:44:40, roughly 100 seconds early, and stamped the trip RIDER_NO_SHOW. A rider cannot be recorded as a no-show at a moment when the waiting period she paid for had not yet expired; the RIDER_NO_SHOW code is mis-selected and the fee is not chargeable on limb (d) either.

    EV-GPS-00203, EV-TRIP-00203 · POL-NS-01

  4. The shortfall cannot be cured by accumulation under POL-NS-06(i).

    Read the whole claim

    The trace shows a single in-geofence interval - run_count 1, the run from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 - so there is no second interval to add. And limb (i) is unavailable on its own terms: EV-ADVIS-00203-01, the traffic advisory, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, so no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory can be asserted to extend the clock. Even doubling 195 seconds would not reach the 300-second minimum.

    EV-GPS-00203, EV-ADVIS-00203-01 · POL-NS-06

  5. The rider was not an absent rider.

    Read the whole claim

    Her own device track carries 60 qualifying fixes placing her between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pickup pin - inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius - continuously across the waiting window, and she messaged the driver at 19:42:50 to say she was coming down. Any reading of the record as a rider who failed to appear is contradicted by the rider's track; the charge fails on the driver's clock in any event. For transparency: EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (MSG-00203-002 is contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'); I do not rest the refund on it, and the presence figures come from EV-GPS-00203, which the pre-pass assessed COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

    EV-GPS-00203, EV-TRIP-00203, EV-CHAT-00203 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

  6. No driver compensation can be paid on this record, and the refund is the whole contested sum.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not; POL-NS-06 states that where cumulative dwell falls short of the minimum the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. The ledger confirms the fee_charged of 4.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on a FULL_REFUND the rider recovers the entire $4.00 and nothing is left standing against her.

    EV-FARE-00203, EV-GPS-00203, EV-DPROF-00203 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03

  7. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged, so this should be decided on the arithmetic rather than sent to human review.

    Read the whole claim

    rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 limb (d) requires; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) cannot fire; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 - below the 4 of the first limb - and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 131 is 0.015, below the 0.08 second limb, so both limbs fail and no compensation is withheld on that ground either. The deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, above the 0.70 floor of POL-GEN-02 and POL-NS-09(a).

    EV-RPROF-00203, EV-DPROF-00203, EV-GPS-00203 · POL-NS-09, POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-02

  8. The one impaired artifact in the bundle does not cap confidence or force escalation.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-CHAT-00203 sits at weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, and that impairment is schema-level only: it meets no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08. There is no clock-skew tag on either EV-TRIP-00203 or EV-GPS-00203 (both COMPLETE, no issues); the trace reports gaps of [] and max_gap_sec 0.0 with 60 fixes across the window, so there is no gap over 120 seconds; the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3; and the 4.00 cancellation line reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is satisfied. Under POL-GEN-02 the chat is down-weighted in confidence when used, and I have not used it as the ground of the refund; it does not engage POL-NS-09(e).

Draft 1 - sampled
Rider and driver: the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider. No compensation is payable to the driver. The fee stands or falls on the waiting clock, and the clock does not reach the required period. THE FIGURES. The driver's own trace (EV-GPS-00203, weight 1.0, unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, 60 fixes) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20 and stationary at the pin until 19:44:35 — a single continuous in-geofence dwell of 195 seconds, with no second interval and no sampling gap (max_gap_sec 0.0). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec in EV-TRIP-00203 (weight 1.0), exactly as POL-NS-01(c) directs and not the 180-second default. The shortfall is 105 seconds. The driver cancelled at 19:44:40 and stamped the trip RIDER_NO_SHOW. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable on that shortfall alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied; the waiting period is the consideration she paid the fee for. POL-NS-01(c) is therefore broken and limb (d) fails independently, because limb (d) requires the termination to fall at or after the required dwell elapsed: 300 seconds from 19:41:20 would run out about 19:46:20, and the driver cancelled roughly 100 seconds early. THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS.
